faq.sectionSubtitle: Everything you need to know about Kere.
faq.q1: How do I place a custom clothing order?
faq.a1: Browse the marketplace to find a tailor whose style matches yours, or use our custom designer to describe exactly what you want. Then submit your order and we'll connect you with the right tailor.
faq.q2: What if the finished item doesn't fit?
faq.a2: Every order includes a free revision. If there's a fit issue, your tailor will adjust it at no extra cost. If you're still not satisfied, we offer a full refund.
faq.q3: How long does an order take?
faq.a3: Most orders are completed within 5–14 business days depending on complexity. You'll see the estimated delivery time before confirming your order.
faq.q4: Can I provide my own measurements?
faq.a4: Yes! Our customization forms let you enter exact measurements (chest, waist, hips, length, inseam) in centimeters for a perfect fit.
faq.a5: Yes. We deliver to all major cities across Georgia. Delivery time may vary by location.
faq.q6: How do I become a tailor on Kere?
faq.a6: Click "Sign In" in the navigation and choose the tailor option. Our team will review your application and onboard you within 2–3 business days.
faq.stillHaveQuestionsDesc: Our support team is here to help you with any questions or concerns.

partners.heroSubtitle: Join Kere and start receiving custom clothing orders from real customers. Free to join. No marketing required.
partners.trustLine: Free to join · No subscription · Cancel anytime
partners.whySubtitle: Built specifically for independent tailors who want a reliable stream of custom orders.
partners.vp1Body: Customers come to Kere ready to commission custom clothes. Every order that matches your specialty lands directly in your dashboard.
partners.vp2Body: Build a professional profile with photos of your best pieces. Your products appear in the Kere marketplace and get discovered by new customers every day.
partners.vp3Body: No monthly fees, no upfront cost. Create your profile, list your products, and start selling. We only succeed when you succeed.
partners.vp4Body: Communicate directly with customers before starting any order. Discuss measurements, fabrics, and special requests — no middleman.
partners.vp5Body: Earn verified reviews from satisfied customers. A strong Kere profile brings a steady stream of new commissions to your workshop.
partners.vp6Body: We handle discovery and order management. You focus on making beautiful clothes. No marketing budget required.
partners.howSubtitle: Three steps from signup to your first order.
partners.step1Body: Sign up in under two minutes. Add your bio, specialties, years of experience, and a profile photo so customers know who they're ordering from.
partners.step2Body: Add at least 3 items to your shop — garment types, fabrics, and prices you offer. Great photos make a big difference.
partners.step3Body: Once your profile is live, customers can browse your work and submit custom orders. You review, confirm details, and get to work.
partners.tailorsSubtitle: These independent tailors grow their businesses through the platform every day.
partners.faq1q: Is there a fee to join Kere as a tailor?
partners.faq1a: No — joining is completely free. You create your profile, list your products, and start accepting orders without any upfront payment or subscription.
partners.faq2q: How do I get paid for my orders?
partners.faq2a: You agree pricing directly with the customer before starting. Payment details are discussed between you and the customer — Kere facilitates the connection and order management.
partners.faq3q: What types of garments can I offer?
partners.faq3a: Any custom-made clothing: dresses, shirts, trousers, jackets, skirts, coats, and more. You list exactly what you make and customers browse accordingly.
partners.faq4q: How long until I receive my first order?
partners.faq4a: Most active tailors with a complete profile (3+ products and a bio with photos) receive their first inquiry within the first two weeks.
partners.faq5q: Can I limit the orders I accept?
partners.faq5a: Absolutely. You review every order request before confirming. If you're fully booked or the project isn't right for you, you can decline.
partners.finalSubtitle: Join Georgia's fastest-growing custom clothing platform. Create your profile today and reach customers who are already looking for your craft.

aboutUs.heroDesc: Kere was founded in Tbilisi with a simple belief: clothing should fit the person wearing it, not the other way around. We built a marketplace that connects customers directly with Georgia's most talented independent tailors.
aboutUs.whyP1: Georgia has a long tradition of skilled textile work. Tbilisi alone is home to hundreds of independent tailors — master craftspeople who learned their trade over decades. But most of them had no way to reach customers beyond word-of-mouth.
aboutUs.whyP2: At the same time, customers struggled to find custom clothing without knowing someone personally. Fast fashion filled the gap, but at a cost: ill-fitting clothes, poor quality, and mountains of waste.
aboutUs.whyP3: Kere bridges that gap. We give tailors a professional storefront and give customers access to truly bespoke clothing — at prices that are fair for everyone.
aboutUs.v1Desc: Every garment on Kere is made by hand by a skilled tailor. We celebrate the artistry that goes into every stitch.
aboutUs.v2Desc: We exist to support local Georgian tailors — giving them a platform to reach customers beyond their neighborhood workshop.
aboutUs.v3Desc: Not happy with your order? We stand behind every purchase. Our team will work with the tailor to make it right.
aboutUs.v4Desc: Custom clothing means no waste. Each piece is made for you specifically — no overproduction, no landfill.
aboutUs.ctaDesc: Whether you're a customer or a tailor, there's a place for you on Kere.

howItWorks.heroDesc: From choosing your design to receiving your custom garment — here's exactly how it works.
howItWorks.s1Desc: Explore hundreds of clothing items crafted by Tbilisi-based tailors. Filter by category, price, or fabric. Each listing shows the tailor's profile and past work.
howItWorks.s2Desc: Select your color, size, and fabric. Enter your exact measurements — chest, waist, hips, and length — for a truly tailored piece that fits you perfectly.
howItWorks.s3Desc: Your order goes directly to a verified local tailor. They cut, stitch, and finish your garment by hand. You'll receive updates as your order progresses.
howItWorks.s4Desc: Once complete, your custom garment is carefully packaged and delivered. Not satisfied? Our quality guarantee means we'll make it right.

helpCenter.heroDesc: Find answers to common questions about ordering, measurements, delivery, and more.
helpCenter.t1q1: How do I place a custom order?
helpCenter.t1a1: Browse the marketplace, select a product, choose your size and color, enter your measurements, and click Order. You'll need a customer account to complete checkout.
helpCenter.t1q2: Can I order without entering measurements?
helpCenter.t1a2: Yes — measurements are optional. If you skip them, the tailor will make the garment to the standard size you select. For the best fit, we recommend entering measurements.
helpCenter.t1q3: How do I track my order?
helpCenter.t1a3: Go to your Customer Dashboard. Each order shows its current status: Pending → In Progress → Shipped → Delivered.
helpCenter.t2a1: Use a soft measuring tape. Measure over light-fitting clothing or directly on skin. Check our Size Guide for step-by-step instructions with diagrams.
helpCenter.t2a2: Enter your exact measurements rather than choosing a standard size. The tailor will cut to your measurements.
helpCenter.t2q3: I entered the wrong measurements — what now?
helpCenter.t2a3: Contact us immediately via the Email Support button. If your order hasn't entered production yet, we can update them.
helpCenter.t3a1: Most orders are completed in 7–14 business days. Complex items or heavy customisation may take up to 21 days. Shipping within Georgia takes 1–3 business days after completion.
helpCenter.t3a2: Currently Kere serves customers within Georgia only. International shipping is on our roadmap for 2025.
helpCenter.t3q3: My order says "Shipped" but I haven't received it.
helpCenter.t3a3: Please allow 3 business days after the "Shipped" status before contacting support. Delays may occur due to courier conditions.
helpCenter.t4q1: Can I return a custom-made item?
helpCenter.t4a1: Because garments are made to order, we don't accept returns for change of mind. However, if the item doesn't match what you ordered or has a quality defect, contact us within 7 days.
helpCenter.t4q2: How do I request an alteration?
helpCenter.t4a2: If the fit is off, contact support within 7 days of delivery. We'll arrange for the tailor to make adjustments at no extra charge.
helpCenter.t4a3: Approved refunds are processed within 5–10 business days to your original payment method. See our Refund Policy for full details.
helpCenter.t5q1: What payment methods do you accept?
helpCenter.t5a1: We accept Visa and Mastercard credit/debit cards. All payments are processed securely.
helpCenter.t5q2: Is it safe to enter my card details?
helpCenter.t5a2: Yes. Payments are processed by a PCI-DSS compliant payment gateway. Kere never stores your card number.
helpCenter.t5a3: An order summary is available in your Customer Dashboard. Contact support if you need a formal invoice for business purposes.
helpCenter.t6q1: How do I reset my password?
helpCenter.t6a1: Use the "Forgot password" link on the sign-in page. A reset link will be sent to your registered email.
helpCenter.t6q2: How do I contact a tailor?
helpCenter.t6a2: After placing an order, use the notes field in your order detail to send a message to your tailor.
helpCenter.t6q3: How do I contact Kere support?
helpCenter.t6a3: Use the Email Support button below (you'll need to be signed in). We respond within one business day.
helpCenter.stillDesc: Our support team is based in Tbilisi and responds within one business day.
helpCenter.signInNote: You need to be signed in to send a support email.

refund.e2: The tailor cancels the order after payment is received.

measurementGuide.title: Measurement Guide
measurementGuide.chestTip: Wear a light shirt or no shirt for the most accurate result.
measurementGuide.chestStep1: Stand straight with arms relaxed at your sides.
measurementGuide.chestStep2: Wrap the measuring tape around the fullest part of your chest — usually at nipple level.
measurementGuide.chestStep3: Keep the tape horizontal and parallel to the floor.
measurementGuide.chestStep4: Breathe normally — do not suck in or expand your chest.
measurementGuide.chestStep5: Read the tape where it meets itself. That number in cm is your chest measurement.
measurementGuide.waistTip: Measure over bare skin or thin clothing for the best fit.
measurementGuide.waistStep2: Locate your natural waist — the narrowest point of your torso, just above the belly button.
measurementGuide.waistStep3: Wrap the tape around this point, keeping it horizontal.
measurementGuide.waistStep4: The tape should be snug but not tight — you should be able to slide one finger under it.
measurementGuide.waistStep5: Read the measurement where the tape overlaps.
measurementGuide.hipsTip: Stand with feet together for the widest hip reading.
measurementGuide.hipsStep2: Find the widest point of your hips and buttocks — usually about 20 cm below your natural waist.
measurementGuide.hipsStep3: Wrap the tape around this widest point, keeping it level all the way around.
measurementGuide.hipsStep4: Make sure the tape is not twisted and lies flat against your body.
measurementGuide.lengthTip: Have a friend help for the most accurate reading.
measurementGuide.lengthStep2: For tops: start at the highest point of your shoulder (where the seam would sit).
measurementGuide.lengthStep3: For bottoms: start at your natural waist.
measurementGuide.lengthStep4: Run the tape straight down to where you want the garment to end.
measurementGuide.lengthStep5: Keep the tape straight — do not follow the curve of the body.
measurementGuide.chartNote: All measurements in cm. If you are between sizes, choose the larger one and let your tailor adjust.
measurementGuide.chartFootnote: Length refers to top/shirt length from shoulder seam. For trousers, provide inseam separately.
